stories.narrEn: According to PBS NewsHour, other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. DW reports: Washington's governor has denounced the arrests made by ICE officers at Seattle's airport, calling the incident "horrific." BBC reports: ICE said a man and a woman, both Mexican nationals, were arrested for allegedly overstaying their visas.
